items.text:
2025-xx-xx: 12V Dies overnight.
2025-xx-xx: Fixed by moving CCU constant power to switched.

2025-xx-xx: Regen bumps in and out at 60 mph.
2025-xx-xx: Resolved with a new firmware summer 2025.
2025-xx-xx: Need to review range data then update the range estimation table.
2025-xx-xx: Need to update OCV table per cell Chemistry.

2025-xx-xx: Create + Review PreCharge Graph.
2026-03-24: Finished this, saved to drive.
2025-xx-xx: Need to review the ExtTherm calibration table.
2025-xx-xx: Need to review pack capacity data and update MaxCapacity.
2025-xx-xx: Need to review top of pack and bottom of pack logs to determine if the cell protection limiters are working correctly.

2025-xx-xx: Validate gauges set and correct temperature discrepency issue.
2026-03-xx: Resolved, everything was fine.
2025-xx-xx: Need to plot and review vehicle temperatures for both charging and driving.

2025-xx-xx: Need to validate the digital dash.
2026-03-23: Dash updated and under review.
2026-04-02: Discovered the dash shoould be brought up to the master revision then branched again to incorporate erroneous BMS alarm suppression features.
2026-03-25: Need to enter Wi-Fi credentials for the CAN logger.
2025-xx-xx: Should find a way to turn off unused BMS slots, or verify they do nothing.

2026-03-25: Thermistor configurations for group 7 and 8 need to be turned on.
2026-04-02: Resolved, enabled and watched temps go from -127C to 23C.

2026-03-26: Charge BMS Group 5 Cells 1,2,6, and 12 up to the pack cell average.
2026-03-31: Group 5 cells balanced to 14mV. Box ready for assembly.
2026-04-02: Resolved, pack back in shape with an overall delta of ~16mV.

2026-02-xx: Purchase and install CAN logger.
2026-03-16: Logger wired and connectivity to the server verified. Still needs to be physically mounted.
2026-03-25: Logger is mounted now but still needs customer wifi credentials.
2026-02-xx: Verify inverter RTD calibration.

2026-02-xx: Slide cover hits the PRND, buttons will scratch over time.
2026-04-08: Resolved, Aharon adjusted the springs.

2026-03-02: Speedometer zeros to 10 MPH.
2026-03-10: Resolved, This is correct for the vehicle.

2026-03-04: Vehicle does not PreCharge.
2026-03-04: Resolved, Had to correct an ISO-SPI wiring flip and re-terminate some resolver pins.

2026-02-xx: Only 185 of 400 PackVolts showing up in the VCU. Box #2 is missing from the BMS overview.
2026-03-04: Resolved, found ISO-SPI to be flipped between Box #1 and Box #2.

2026-03-xx: Inverter Fault: Resolver Not Connected.
2026-03-04: Resolved, found the crimps on the excitation pins were poor. Remade & problem disappeared.

2026-03-xx: Driveshaft contacts parking brake mount.
2026-03-05: Update, Temporary solution has been deployed, full new center bearing bracket in the works.
2026-04-08: Resolved, any continued work is captured elsewhere.

2026-03-05: The gauges for Charge, Motor Temp, and Battery Temp do not work.
2026-03-06: Resolved, something was swapped & Aharon corrected.

2026-03-05: The power gauge moves backwards.
2026-03-06: Resolved, the IVT was inverted in the VCU.

2026-03-xx: Charge port seems sort of loose and a piece of rubber interferes with the lock latch.
2026-03-24: Resolved, Not a loud click like other vehicles but it does indeed latch.

2026-03-xx: Need to setup the IVT to track energy.
2026-03-24: Resolved, Fixed IVT setup script, ran and verified new CAN messages exist.

2026-03-xx: Need to force CellR somewhere in the middle of the pack.
2026-03-24: Resolved, ran the test process again and determined ~66mOhms for the pack.

2026-03-17: The 12V battery measures 0.2V on one half of the terminals.
2026-03-17: Moved all the leads over to the good half of the battery, Still want to eventually replace.
2026-03-19: Resolved, Brand new battery was installed.

2026-03-19: Range keeps resetting to 410 miles.
2026-03-24: Long term consumption shows 4 Wh/mile while the IVT measures 267 Wh/mile. Asking AEM.
2026-03-31: Believed to be resolved with setting initial odometer reading to 0. In testing.

2026-03-24: Both CAN1 and CAN2 have incorrect termination.
2026-03-25: Resolved, Aharon installed resistors by the digital dash.

2026-03-24: Need to get the firmware burned in again with updated CellR initial values. Have an email out to AEM.
2026-03-31: Current burn is in and under testing.
kW gauge seemed off aroud the 0 breakpoint
Update Wi-Fi
